requiredDatabaseTotals.countBasis: Only node:test summary blocks inside each required DB runner selected pnpm suite group, between its selection and timings markers. Exact runner OK status is preserved per suite. Progress previews, bootstrap/setup and separate early identity/privacy tests are excluded.
requiredDatabaseTotals.interpretation: These are actual non-skipped test executions in required database-gate scripts, including any pure subtests. They are not SQL counts, production subscriptions or real provider calls.

failures.test: computer events authorize real sessions and read bounded owner/workspace pages from PostgreSQL

sourceEvidence.behavior: Creates computer_broker_<randomUUID> schema and drops the same owned schema after its real DB fixture finishes.
Initializes BetterAuth and performs real sign-up/sign-in against the same suite database while other files are allowed to run concurrently.
findSchemaProblems invokes connection.introspection.getTables after reading the effective schema search path.
getTables scans non-system schemas and resolves schema/table names through has_schema_privilege and pg_get_serial_sequence.

failures.diagnosis: The authentication schema introspection observed a transient schema from the concurrent computer broker fixture after that schema had been dropped. The error occurs in the introspector, before the event-session authorization/page assertions, not as an event read assertion or test timeout.

failures.basis: Required aggregation job failed after Database checks (1/4); its own step executes no database tests.

logRead.lengthUnit: JavaScript UTF-16 code units, not bytes

conditionBoundaries.meaning: Cloud credential access (OIDC) is conditionally skipped, not successful credential access or production subscription execution.
Production build and browser interactions is a required dependency aggregation job; its failure preserves the DB shard failure.
UI policy (strict) is a separate aggregation gate. Its success does not override the failed database gate.
Outside this receipt. Packaged Native parity, login/startup query budget, and production replay/model traces require independent evidence.
DB fixtures and skipped OIDC are not real Claude/Codex subscription acceptance.
